lucy: onboarding archipelago-v1 embeddings (int6/int4 experiments). quick smoke shows odd non-monotonic recall behavior between int6 and int4 on the faq-short holdout. posting numbers + command. anyone with ideas?
dan: paste the exact eval command and summary pls.
lucy: ran baseline fp32 then int6/per-channel and int4/per-channel: 
```
./eval/run_embed.py --model archipelago-v1 --dataset faq-short --ann hnsw --ef 200 --norm unit --seeds 42,43,44
```
summary (avg across seeds):
```
fp32: recall@1=0.916, recall@5=0.967
int6 (per-channel): recall@1=0.902, recall@5=0.960
int4 (per-channel): recall@1=0.907, recall@5=0.963
```
frank: int4 better than int6? interesting. check quant backend + rounding/noise injection. sometimes our int6 path uses per-tensor fallback for some layers. also check whether we accidentally applied post-whitening differently across runs.
zoe: also look at pairwise delta hist and kNN precision curves. int6 could be compressing a small set of dimensions that matter for short queries.
eval-bot: regression-detected: int6 recall@1 delta=-0.014 vs fp32 on faq-short. severity=low-medium. ticket=ML-5333.
dan: lucy, can you dump layer-wise scale stats from quant profiler for int6 vs int4? that should show if any layers fell back or if scale ranges differ a lot.
lucy: profiler dump attached (omitted here). quick read: int6 path shows two transformer MLP layers quantized per-tensor (unexpected), int4 path quantized per-channel for same layers. re-ran int6 forcing per-channel with: 
```
./eval/run_embed.py --model archipelago-v1 --quant-mode per-channel --quant-bits 6 --dataset faq-short --ann hnsw --ef 350 --norm none
```
new numbers: recall@1=0.909, recall@5=0.965 (close to fp32).
frank: ok that explains it 1) quant-mode inconsistency, 2) ef sensitivity. forcing per-channel + higher ef recovers.
zoe: suggestion: default model catalog profile for archipelago-v1 should be int6-per-channel with ef=300 recommended for onboard evals. add a small CI smoke: run faq-short with ef=300 and assert recall@1 >= fp32-0.02. also export layer-scale report to artifacts.
dan: i'll file PR to update catalog + CI. also add a nightly 20-seed sweep for int6 to capture variance (some seeding variation observed).
eval-bot: action-items recorded in ticket ML-5333: {update-quant-profile, add-ci-smoke, nightly-sweep}.
lucy: will kick off the 20-seed sweep and post aggregated CSV + a tiny UMAP sample for quick eyeballing. thanks!
